title: Hacking Now Costs 28 Cents: Open AI Models Catch Up Fast
description:
Hacking your company now costs 28 cents 😅 Thats not a joke, its data from the UK's AI Security Institute. Free open models like DeepSeek V4 Pro already match closed systems from 4 months ago on cyberattacks. Same task: 28 cents vs $15 on Opus, like 50x cheaper 🔥 And the safety filters? You just ask again and they fold.

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
